Hello! I’m Reba Dixie C. Somngi, a first-year Bachelor of Science in Computer Science student at the University of the Cordilleras. I’m an ambivert with a curious and creative personality. My interests include technology, arts and creativity, entertainment, music, and fitness. I enjoy learning new things and exploring different interests while working toward my goal of becoming a skilled software and game developer.
